what: Convert Mesh of a 20x10x5 box STL (12 triangles) with one extra zero-area triangle lying on an edge ((0,0,0) (10,0,0) (20,0,0)): refused with 'mesh conversion: degenerate triangle'
method: the zero-area triangle adds no surface; the mesh is the closed box, a constant-section prism, so it converts: V = 20*10*5 = 1000, 6 faces. The STL is written by hand (box-degenerate.stl, the triage's mesh)
